label: OpenAlex
title: OpenAlex Research
subtitle: Searches OpenAlex, an open catalogue of more than 240 million scholarly works, together with their authors, institutions, and citation links.
whenToUse: Used for literature work that needs breadth — finding what has been published on a topic, tracing who cites whom, or judging how active a research area is. The catalogue is open data, so it reaches fields and venues a commercial index can miss.

methods.name: Search Works
methods.description: Searches the catalogue and returns the matching works with their titles, authors, venues, publication years, and citation counts.

methods.name: Get Work
methods.description: Returns the full record of one paper, found by its DOI or OpenAlex ID: every author and their institution, the abstract, topics, funding, and the works it cites.

methods.name: Get Citing Works
methods.description: Lists the later works that cite a given paper, to follow a line of research forward in time.

methods.name: Get Referenced Works
methods.description: Lists the works a given paper cites, to follow its sources back in time.

methods.name: Get Related Works
methods.description: Finds papers close to a given one through shared topics and citations, to widen a search from a single known paper.

methods.name: Resolve References
methods.description: Turns a list of DOIs or OpenAlex IDs into full paper records in one step, for building or checking a reference list.

methods.name: Find Open Access Versions
methods.description: Finds papers on a topic that anyone can read for free, with a link to each free copy.

mediaCaption: An OpenAlex action card listing matching papers with their authors and citation counts
